design_philosophy: Clarity-first minimalism. Zero decoration. Pure function. High contrast typography and 1px structural borders.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID for summary stats. Use strict tabular alignment for data.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 1px border border-[#E5E5E5], NO shadow. Hover: subtle border-black.
surface_strategies.modals_drawers: Solid bg-white, 1px border border-[#E5E5E5], shadow-2xl. No glassmorphism.
surface_strategies.tables: border-collapse layout, 1px border-b on rows, py-4 padding.

components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast bg-black text-white for primary, bg-white border border-gray-200 text-black for secondary.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border border-gray-200, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black focus:border-black, bg-[#FAFAFA]. rounded-sm.
components.badges: rounded-sm px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border
components.file_upload: Dashed border border-gray-300, bg-gray-50, hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors, rounded-sm p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer

icons.style: Regular or Light weight, size 20px for inline, 24px for actions, 48px for empty states

motion.modals: Fade in, slide up slightly (translate-y-2 to 0)

dashboard.layout: Header with App Name and 'Add Payment' button. Top section: 4 Summary Cards. Main section: Filter bar (Search, Status Dropdown) and Export button. Below: Full width table of payments.

add_payment_modal.layout: Grid layout. Form fields: Amount (number), Date (datepicker), Merchant (text), Payment Method (Select: UPI, Card, NetBanking), Txn ID (text), Bank Name (text), Status (Select: Pending, Refunded, Lost), Notes (textarea). File Upload for Screenshot. Submit and Cancel buttons.

payment_detail_modal.layout: 2-column grid on desktop, stacked on mobile. Left: Payment metadata and Edit Status dropdown. Right: Screenshot viewer with zoom capability.

testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-payment-button', data-testid='export-csv-button', data-testid='payment-row-{id}', etc.)
instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: @phosphor-icons/react, date-fns, react-dropzone (or similar for file upload), papaparse (or similar for CSV export)
Use Shadcn UI components for Select, Dialog, Table, Input, Button, DatePicker
Ensure all components have data-testid attributes
Implement local storage or standard API for data persistence, including mock upload for screenshots if no real backend
Maintain 1px border structural aesthetic, avoiding shadows for cards
Apply 'Chivo' font to all headings and 'Inter' to body. You may need to import them from Google Fonts.
